description.value: Donair Drive is a fast-casual donair restaurant on Nelson Street in the heart of downtown Vancouver, serving fresh-made donairs, wraps, poutines, and wings with halal meats and falafel options. Positioned steps from Granville Street and the West End, it is a well-known late-night option for locals and visitors in a dense cycling corridor. Cyclists can order pickup online or by phone, with third-party delivery also available through DoorDash, Uber Eats, and SkipTheDishes.
